summary.building: A 3000-piece bearer NFT collection with an isolated treasury per token and pooled Delta LP strategy shares.
summary.topRisk: Stock Token eligibility and securities restrictions conflict with unrestricted bearer-NFT transfers.
summary.mustDecideFirst: Use counsel-approved eligibility checks at mint, transfer, and redemption, or remove Stock Tokens.
summary.watchOutFor: Most published Delta stake, farm, zap, and manager contracts lack verified public source and complete ABI material.

risks.title: Core contracts are not source-verified
risks.detail: Stake, farm, zap, oracle, and manager custody and upgrade behavior cannot be independently reviewed from published source.

risks.title: Rewards are not automatically compounded
risks.detail: Seven-day streaming and manual claiming require explicit NAV and exit accounting.

risks.title: Direct per-NFT positions do not scale
risks.detail: Maintaining up to 3000 separate ranges creates excessive keeper and gas overhead.

risks.title: Range and inventory risk
risks.detail: Out-of-range positions stop earning fees and become one-sided.

risks.title: Public infrastructure is not production-grade
risks.detail: The public RPC is rate limited and not recommended for production.

risks.title: L2 governance and validator dependency
risks.detail: Security Council and validator operation are external trust assumptions.

risks.title: Brand misuse can block launch
risks.detail: Robinhood marks cannot appear in NFT art, metadata, or contract attributes.

risks.title: Jurisdiction and securities restrictions
risks.detail: An unrestricted NFT wrapper can bypass restrictions on the underlying Stock Tokens.

risks.title: Multiplier double-counting
risks.detail: Mixing adjusted onchain feeds with REST prices and uiMultiplier can silently corrupt NAV.

risks.title: 24/5 and corporate-action pauses
risks.detail: Price-dependent operations must stop when feeds are stale or paused.

risks.title: Issuer and instrument risk
risks.detail: The tokens are issuer debt securities, not direct shareholder rights.

risks.title: Missing sequencer-feed address
risks.detail: Robinhood recommends an uptime check but no official Robinhood Chain Chainlink feed address was found.

risks.title: Stale-price misuse
risks.detail: A last 24/5 answer must not be treated as a live weekend price.

risks.title: Slippage and range manipulation
risks.detail: Weak minimums, deadlines, or price checks expose deposits and rebalances.

risks.title: Position-NFT custody
risks.detail: Token IDs and lifecycle approvals must remain recoverable and auditable.

risks.title: Out-of-range drift
risks.detail: Positions may stop earning and become concentrated in one asset.

risks.title: Multi-asset semantic mismatch
risks.detail: A two-asset LP is not a native single-asset ERC-4626 vault.

risks.title: Inflation and donation attacks
risks.detail: Unprotected initial share accounting can dilute subsequent deposits.

risks.title: Clone initialization or salt mistakes
risks.detail: A bad initializer or ambiguous salt can compromise treasury ownership.

risks.title: Custom hook risk
risks.detail: Transfer eligibility and exit locks require complete lifecycle tests.

preCodingDecisions.title: Eligibility model
preCodingDecisions.detail: Counsel-approved transfer and redemption gating or removal of Stock Tokens.

preCodingDecisions.title: Initial asset manifest
preCodingDecisions.detail: Pin verified Stock Tokens, feeds, Delta pools, routers, and risk limits.

preCodingDecisions.title: Delta integration boundary
preCodingDecisions.detail: Obtain reviewable source and ABI material or constrain v1 to the verified v3 builder.

preCodingDecisions.title: Strategy share interface
preCodingDecisions.detail: Define single-asset accounting plus explicit in-kind two-asset exit.

preCodingDecisions.title: Oracle circuit breaker
preCodingDecisions.detail: Confirm sequencer health source or implement an approved alternative.

requirementsCorrections.detail: Stock Tokens are issuer debt securities, not direct ownership of shares.
Delta does not currently auto-compound and withdrawals return both assets.
Eligibility must be enforced at mint, transfer, and redemption.
Use pooled Delta strategy shares rather than 3000 default direct LP positions.
Last-NFT behavior, exit tax, fee splits, and the initial asset manifest must be fixed at launch.

openQuestions: Unresolvable from public sources: the verified source, complete ABI, and upgrade controls for Delta stake/farm/zap/manager contracts.
Unresolvable from public sources: an official Chainlink sequencer-uptime feed address for Robinhood Chain.
Requires product counsel rather than public documentation: the exact eligible-jurisdiction and transfer policy for this NFT wrapper.
